headline: Paraguay Senate Removes President Peña Over Collapse of Ueno Bank
summary: Paraguay's Senate removed President Santiago Peña from office and placed him under house arrest over the collapse of Ueno Bank, with Vice President Pedro Alliana assuming power.
why: Political upheaval and bank failures in Paraguay create heightened systemic banking risk and sovereign credit uncertainty in the Mercosur region.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: The Senate removed the sitting president following a systemic bank collapse, creating major political and financial instability.
